name: "Otherwise, it can't …" — Bonds of Faith, Mishra's Domination; Possession Engine's rule lasts while you control it
notes: Found while auditing targeted can't-rules (2026-11-17). "Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 as long as it's a Human. Otherwise, it can't attack or block." (Bonds of Faith) gave the Human "Can't attack or block" and every other creature nothing: the branch splitter (_splitConditionalBranches) did not count a can't-rule as continuous, so the "Otherwise" sentence kept the line's own condition. It now goes to a line of its own with the condition negated (_BRANCH_CONTINUOUS_VERB_RE). Possession Engine's second sentence has its own "for as long as you control this Vehicle" (_getConditionOfOwnSentence).
